features.feature_value: Uses Second Amendment rights presented as non-negotiable
features.rationale: The post centers the Second Amendment and explicitly frames it as absolute.

features.feature_value: Conditional justification tied to whether representatives reflect beliefs
features.evidence_span: "If the messages from your elected representative government don't represent your beliefs... it's because they either dont believe the message, or, they're in power"
features.rationale: It uses an if-then structure to explain why messaging differs from the speaker’s beliefs.

features.feature_value: Dehumanizing insult using head of lettuce/turnip metaphors
features.evidence_span: "The average leftist has the intellect of a head of lettuce."
features.rationale: The text relies on mocking insults to delegitimize an outgroup (leftists/right-wingers) rather than policy debate.

features.feature_value: Calls for unity only in a high-stakes contrast (left vs fascism / right vs communism)
features.evidence_span: "when it comes to left vs fascism, all decent people will unite"
features.rationale: It draws a moral-consensus claim that people must unite against an extreme threat.

features.feature_value: Accuses a named public figure of profiting from the opposite cause
features.evidence_span: "Steyer became a billionaire... He hates fossil fuels that he made billions off of now."
features.rationale: The argument targets hypocrisy by contrasting stated beliefs with prior business gains.

features.feature_value: Uses cost figures and a rhetorical question framed as criticism
features.evidence_span: "Remember: the per-barrel costs... is anywhere from 50 cents to $2 per barrel... This is \"strangling\"?"
features.rationale: It presents numeric cost information and then challenges a label via a rhetorical question.

features.feature_value: Uses in-group/out-group slang labels (Magats/Libs) and puppet framing
features.rationale: Group-denigrating labels and “puppet” language create sharp us-vs-them directionality in a political comparison.

features.feature_value: Expresses negative affect about ongoing political period
features.evidence_span: "This is going to be a tiring 6 months"
features.rationale: The post is primarily expressive, venting about an expected period of political discourse.
